data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出内外双层自博弈编排自改进，失败蒸馏为技能并内化为参数，技能撤除驱动下一轮，具备持续闭环。

scope_support.feedback_quote: the outer loop withdraws each skill once a controlled evaluation within self-play shows that the orchestrator performs as well without it
scope_support.object_quote: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrator on self-chosen tasks
scope_support.persistence_quote: failures are distilled into skills, skills into parameters, and withdrawals lead the Proposer to new failures, so the orchestrator moves toward zero-skill deployment.
